title: founders-to-staff-clarity-note-and-30-60-90-sync-v0-1
body:
Purpose:
This note is a compact, non-prescriptive summary from the founders to the company ahead of the March all-hands. It's intended to: align cross-functional decision-making, surface non-obvious risks, and seed a concrete 30/60/90 commitments list that squads can adopt or adapt.

High-level exec update (TL;DR):
- Business: Healthy usage growth in Hosted API (+28% M/M for two months) but unit economics vary by model family.
- Product: Dedicated rollouts on schedule; two enterprise pilots in final integration tests.
- Ops/Reliability: Incidents down, but regional burst capacity needs clearer pre-approval flows.
- People: Hiring remains prioritized for SRE and Solutions Engineering; headcount plan for Q3 under review.

What we need from teams before the all-hands (asks):
1) One-sentence risk statement (what could cause us to miss our top OKR) — due EOD next Tuesday. Include signal(s) you watch.
2) Narrow list of 30/60/90 commitments aligned to company OKRs (see draft below). Teams should keep to 3 commitments max.
3) A single slide or one-paragraph customer story or operational incident that taught a clear lesson.

Draft company-level OKRs (for discussion, keep concise):
- Objective A: Make inference predictable and cheaper to operate for customers.
  - KR A1: Reduce median token cost per request across hosted API by 12% vs baseline (measurement: token-adjusted infra cost).
  - KR A2: Ship two quantization/engine profiles with verified latency/cost tradeoffs and >95% backward-compat acceptance rate from canary tests.

- Objective B: Increase platform adoption in mid-market customers.
  - KR B1: Convert 6 pilot accounts to paid Dedicated plans with SLAs signed.
  - KR B2: Achieve NPS >= 55 on Dedicated onboarding surveys.

- Objective C: Keep the platform resilient during peak usage windows.
  - KR C1: <1.5% customer-impacting error rate in peak load tests over rolling 30d.
  - KR C2: Validate automatic fallback policies across three failure scenarios with documented runbook changes.

Notes on metrics & measurement:
- Token cost baseline: Feb-2026 avg token-adjusted infra cost (shared in analytics dashboard).
- Acceptance rate for profiles: measured by canary sample size and quality regression checks (linked tests).
- All KRs map to dashboards in Console -> exec/okr-slate. If you don't see your metric, ping analytics-ops.

30/60/90 commitments (company guidance template)
- 0-30 days (March):
  - Finalize quantized-engine shipping checklist and complete two canaries for medium-severity workloads. Owner: eng-serving-runtime.
  - Create pre-approved burst-capacity playbook and chargeback guideline. Owner: platform-engineering + finance.
  - Comm plan for Dedicated pilots: customer-facing collateral + SRE oncall rota. Owner: solutions-engineering.
- 31-60 days (April):
  - Rollout quantized profiles to 20% of traffic for compatible models with rollback triggers.
  - Close top three friction points in Dedicated onboarding flow (documented in JIRA).
  - Run regional failover drill with partner region 2 and publish incident retro.
- 61-90 days (May):
  - Validate cost delta target and report variance by model family.
  - Convert two pilot accounts to paid Dedicated with SLAs.
  - Update Console to show token-level attribution by tenant and route.

All-hands run-of-show (30 minutes exec block + team breakouts):
- 0-7m: Founders' note + headline metrics (Nina)
- 7-14m: Product & Reliability highlights (Samir + Lena)
- 14-22m: Customer story + lessons (Solutions Eng rep)
- 22-30m: Immediate asks and where to sign up for 30/60/90 adoption (interactive poll)
- Breakout: Teams submit their 3 commitments to the shared spreadsheet for roll-up.

Risks & escalation ladder (informal):
- Risk: Cost regression from unanticipated model mix. Signal: token-cost delta >7% week-over-week. Escalation: eng-serving-runtime -> infra -> founders.
- Risk: Dedicated pilot stall because of legal/compliance delays. Signal: contract review not started within 10 business days of kickoff. Escalation: sales-eng -> legal -> CEO office.

Open questions we're resolving this week (notes to self):
- Should we change the cadence for cost reporting from weekly to twice-weekly during the ramp? (pros/cons arguments in thread #finance-costs).
- Do we require a default canary sample size for all engine changes? Proposal: 3% traffic or min 10k requests, whichever larger.

Logistics & links:
- Submit slide/incident story here: https://drive.example.com/forms/ah-stories (form closes in 5 business days)
- Shared commitments sheet: https://sheets.example.com/ah-commitments (team-edit)
- Relevant Jira tickets: JIRA-1101 (burst-capacity playbook), JIRA-1127 (quantized-engine checklist)

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Founders: finalize 5-minute script and record 1x rehearsal for execs. Owner: Nina. Due: 2026-03-10.
- Eng-serving-runtime: lock down canary protocol and publish test harness. Owner: Tom Walker. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Platform-eng + Finance: draft burst-capacity chargeback and sign-off flow. Owner: Priya Kapoor + finance lead. Due: 2026-03-18.

Notes to reviewers: This is intentionally concise and partly prescriptive; please add comments inline rather than creating competing versions. We'll merge final asks into the all-hands packet 48 hours before the event.

-- end of note --
